surface_name: API Gateway HTTP API Lambda payload format
title: event.httpMethod and event.path are undefined in a Lambda behind an API Gateway HTTP API
symptoms: Handler written for a REST API or ALB routes everything to the default branch
cause: HTTP APIs created in the console use payload format 2.0, which moves the method and path to requestContext.http and rawPath. Format 2.0 also merges duplicate headers and query strings with commas.
fix: Read the 2.0 fields, or set the integration payloadFormatVersion to 1.0 if the handler expects the REST API shape. The CLI, CloudFormation and SDKs require you to choose it explicitly.
affected: API Gateway HTTP APIs (apigatewayv2) with payload format version 2.0, the console default
